name: brainstem
description: Permission-scoped engineering agents with bounded repository evidence and durable workflow gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run independent, permission-scoped engineering agents on bounded repository evidence.
interface.longDescription: Brainstem gives each engineering role bounded repository evidence, a least-privilege identity, and durable workflow gates for design, implementation, verification, and review.
defaultPrompt: Use Brainstem to retrieve the smallest relevant context and start an evidence-gated workflow for this task.
